hook: A CRISPR swab test detects Tasmanian devil facial tumour DNA in the field.
summary: Using the SHERLOCK method, which pairs isothermal DNA amplification with CRISPR-triggered reporters, the team built a portable test for both transmissible cancers, DFT1 and DFT2, sensitive to attomolar DNA. It detected DFT1 from non-invasive swabs in the field. Field confirmation covered DFT1 only, and detecting tumours before they are visible still needs wider validation.
title: Development of a point-of-care field test for Tasmanian devil facial tumour disease.
